plugins.name: sdd
plugins.description: Story Driven Development workflow for Claude Code. Keeps your documentation and code in sync via status tracking and git-diff-based prompts.

skills.name: sdd-remote
skills.description: Remote sync workflow for Story Driven Development. Use this skill whenever the user asks to pull from remote, push changes to SDD Flow, enrich drafts, update local state from remote, publish local updates, process remote drafts, or run a remote worker job (enrich or sync). Also trigger on phrases like "sdd pull", "sdd push", "sync with SDD Flow", "enrich this CR", "push the remote updates", "pull the latest specs".
skills.description_zh: 执行 Story Driven Development 的远端同步，拉取最新规格、推送本地更新、补充草稿、处理远端草稿和运行 enrich 或 sync worker，连接 SDD Flow 与本地状态。

skills.name: sdd
skills.description: Story Driven Development workflow. Use this skill whenever working in a project that has `.sdd/config.yaml`, or when the user mentions SDD, sdd sync, story driven development, spec-driven development, change requests, bugs, or asks to implement a feature described in `product/` or `system/`. Also trigger on phrases like "sync the docs", "mark synced", "apply this CR", "fix this bug" when an SDD project is detected.
skills.description_zh: 为含 .sdd/config.yaml 的项目提供 Story Driven Development 工作流，处理 SDD 同步、规格驱动开发、变更请求和缺陷，以及实现 product/ 或 system/ 中描述的功能。

commands.name: sdd-bugs

commands.name: sdd-crs
commands.description: Show pending Change Requests in the SDD project and offer to apply them

commands.name: sdd-pull
commands.description: Pull the latest specs from the SDD Flow remote

commands.name: sdd-push
commands.description: Push local SDD updates to the SDD Flow remote

commands.name: sdd-status
commands.description: Show SDD project status — all doc files and their sync state

commands.name: sdd-sync
commands.description: Run the SDD sync loop — bugs, CRs, then implement pending docs
